routes.notes: displays poem selection form with buttons for poem1.txt, poem2.txt, poem3.txt
displays content of poem1.txt inside <pre> tags
displays content of poem2.txt inside <pre> tags

observations: GET /poems/?poem=<filename> returns file contents rendered in <pre> tags.
The poem parameter controls which file is read and displayed.
Source code shows PHP file_get_contents() called directly on user input with no validation or path restriction.
A flag.txt file exists in the parent directory of the poems folder.
